# João Paulo Sales Magalhães — Backend & Cloud Engineer

## Professional focus

João Paulo Sales Magalhães is a Backend & Cloud Engineer focused on Python, FastAPI, AWS, serverless systems, cloud-native applications, REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, Docker, and CI/CD.

João is interested in international Backend and Cloud Engineering opportunities, especially with product companies in Portugal and across Europe.

## Production case studies

- Salesforce serverless integration: https://joaosalesdev.github.io/portfolio/en/projects/salesforce-serverless-integration/
  Distributed integration using Amazon API Gateway, Amazon SQS, AWS Lambda, asynchronous processing, failure handling, and external systems.

- Melita AI Agent: https://joaosalesdev.github.io/portfolio/en/projects/melita-ai-agent/
  Python and AWS Lambda application integrating Telegram, OpenAI, LangChain, LinkedIn, Docker, automated tests, and CI/CD.

- Business process automations: https://joaosalesdev.github.io/portfolio/en/projects/business-process-automations/
  Production automation using Python, AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS, EventBridge, Step Functions, Docker, ECR, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager.

- Italian learning SaaS: https://joaosalesdev.github.io/portfolio/en/projects/italian-learning-saas/
  Production SaaS platform covering academic management, online learning, payments, REST APIs, and external service integrations.
